texts.33:
The Earth is wrapped in a layer of air called the atmosphere. The Sun's rays pass through it and warm the land and the sea. The warm ground gives off heat back upward, but some of it is trapped by greenhouse gases – mainly carbon dioxide and methane. This is the greenhouse effect, and thanks to it the average temperature on the Earth's surface is pleasant: about 15 degrees.

Since the Industrial Revolution, about two hundred years ago, people have been burning huge amounts of coal, oil and natural gas. Burning releases carbon dioxide. At the same time, forests are being cut down, so fewer trees absorb the gas from the air. The amount of greenhouse gases has gone up, and the average temperature has risen by more than one degree.

This change has consequences: glaciers are melting, the sea level is rising, and heat waves, droughts and floods are becoming more frequent. Many species of plants and animals find it hard to adapt to the changes.

What can we do? Make electricity from solar and wind energy, travel by public transportation or by bicycle, save electricity, plant trees and recycle. Every small step helps.

questions.he: רוכב נוסע 15 קמ״ש במשך שעתיים. כמה ק״מ עבר?
questions.q: A cyclist rides at 15 km/h for two hours. How many km does he cover?
questions.x: Distance = speed × time: 15 × 2

questions.he: רצה במהירות 5 מטר לשנייה. כמה זמן ל-400 מטר?
questions.q: A runner runs at 5 m/s. How long does 400 m take her?
questions.x: Time = distance ÷ speed: 400 ÷ 5

questions.he: באיזו יחידה מודדים מהירות של מכונית?
questions.q: What unit is a car's speed measured in?
questions.x: Kilometers per hour – distance divided by time

questions.he: מי הרץ המהיר ביותר בטבלה?
questions.q: Who is the fastest runner in the table?
questions.x: The same distance in the shortest time

questions.he: טיול של 200 ק״מ ארך 4 שעות. מה המהירות הממוצעת?
questions.q: A 200 km trip took 4 hours. What was the average speed?

questions.he: חילזון זוחל סנטימטר אחד בשנייה. כמה ס״מ יעבור בדקה?
questions.q: A snail crawls one centimeter per second. How many cm will it crawl in a minute?
questions.x: A minute has 60 seconds

questions.he: שתי מכוניות נסעו שעה: א 80 ק״מ, ב 60 ק״מ. מי מהירה?
questions.q: Two cars drove for one hour: A 80 km, B 60 km. Which is faster?
questions.x: In the same time, A covered a longer distance

questions.he: איזו תנועה מראה הגרף?
questions.q: What kind of motion does the graph show?
questions.x: Each second, the same distance is added

questions.he: לפי הגרף, מה עושה הגוף?
questions.q: According to the graph, what is the object doing?
questions.x: Its position doesn't change over time

questions.he: מה המהירות לפי הטבלה?
questions.q: What is the speed according to the table?
questions.x: Every 2 seconds, another 10 meters

questions.he: לפי הכרטיס, איזה גוף מהיר יותר?
questions.q: According to the card, which object is faster?
questions.x: A steep line – more distance in the same time

questions.he: לפי הגרף, מה קורה למהירות הגוף?
questions.q: According to the graph, what happens to the object's speed?
questions.x: Each second it covers more meters

questions.he: לפי הגרף, איך משתנה מהירות הגוף?
questions.q: According to the graph, how does the object's speed change?
questions.x: Each second it covers fewer meters

questions.he: המרחק מהבית קטן עם הזמן. מה עושה הילד?
questions.q: The distance from home gets smaller over time. What is the child doing?
questions.x: The distance from home goes down

questions.he: לפי הטבלה, כמה ק״מ ייסע הרכב אחרי 4 שעות?
questions.q: According to the table, how far will the car travel in 4 hours?
questions.x: 60 km each hour: 60 × 4

questions.he: מה עושה הגוף בין שנייה 1 לשנייה 2?
questions.q: What is the object doing between second 1 and second 2?
questions.x: Its position didn't change – the object stood still

questions.he: מה מראה השיפוע בגרף דרך-זמן?
questions.q: What does the slope of a distance-time graph show?
questions.x: A steeper slope – a greater speed

questions.he: כמה הורים משתתפים ברבייה מינית?
questions.q: How many parents take part in sexual reproduction?
questions.x: A sperm cell from the male and an egg from the female

questions.he: כמה הורים יש ברבייה אל-מינית?
questions.q: How many parents are there in asexual reproduction?
questions.x: The offspring come from a single parent

questions.he: צאצאים מרבייה אל-מינית הם…
questions.q: Offspring from asexual reproduction are…
questions.x: They are copies of the parent

questions.he: מה היתרון של רבייה מינית?
questions.q: What is the advantage of sexual reproduction?
questions.x: Variety helps living things adapt to changes

questions.he: מה היתרון של רבייה אל-מינית?
questions.q: What is the advantage of asexual reproduction?
questions.x: There's no need to find a mate

questions.he: איך נקרא האיחוד של תא זרע וביצית?
questions.q: What is the joining of a sperm cell and an egg called?
questions.x: Fertilization – the start of a new organism

questions.he: פקעת של תפוח אדמה מצמיחה צמח חדש. איזו רבייה זו?
questions.q: A potato tuber grows a new plant. Which type of reproduction is this?
questions.x: A part of the plant – no fertilization

questions.he: שותלים ייחור (ענף) של גפן. איזו רבייה זו?
questions.q: A grapevine cutting (a branch) is planted. Which type of reproduction is this?
questions.x: The new plant is identical to the vine it came from

questions.he: איך נקרא התהליך שבו חיידק אחד הופך לשניים?
questions.q: What do we call the process in which one bacterium becomes two?
questions.x: One cell splits into two

questions.he: תות שדה מצמיח צמחים חדשים משלוחות. מה נכון עליהם?
questions.q: A strawberry plant grows new plants from runners. What is true about them?
questions.x: Runners – asexual reproduction

questions.he: מהו איבר הרבייה של צמח פורח?
questions.q: What is the reproductive organ of a flowering plant?
questions.x: Reproductive cells form in the flower

questions.he: איך נקרא מעבר אבקה מאבקן לצלקת?
questions.q: What is the transfer of pollen from a stamen to a stigma called?
questions.x: Pollination comes before fertilization

questions.he: מי מעביר אבקה בין פרחים?
questions.q: What carries pollen between flowers?
questions.x: Bees, butterflies – and the wind too

questions.he: איפה נוצרים גרגרי האבקה?
questions.q: Where are pollen grains made?
questions.x: The stamen – the flower's male part

questions.he: מהו החלק הנקבי בפרח?
questions.q: What is the female part of a flower?
questions.x: Pistil: stigma, style and ovary

questions.he: למה הופכת השחלה של הפרח אחרי ההפריה?
questions.q: What does a flower's ovary become after fertilization?
questions.x: The fruit surrounds the seeds

questions.he: מה צריך זרע כדי לנבוט?
questions.q: What does a seed need to germinate?
questions.x: Most seeds germinate even in the dark

questions.he: למה לפרחים צבעים וצוף מתוק?
questions.q: Why do flowers have colors and sweet nectar?
questions.x: The insect comes for nectar and picks up pollen.

questions.he: ציפור אוכלת פרי עסיסי. במה היא עוזרת לצמח?
questions.q: A bird eats a juicy fruit. How does it help the plant?
questions.x: The seeds come out somewhere else.

questions.he: לזרעים שנישאים ברוח יש בדרך כלל…
questions.q: Seeds carried by the wind usually have…
questions.x: Light parts that the wind can carry.

questions.he: מה השלב שבין הזחל לפרפר?
questions.q: What stage comes between the caterpillar and the butterfly?
questions.x: Egg → caterpillar → pupa → butterfly

questions.he: ראשן הוא שלב בהתפתחות של…
questions.q: A tadpole is a stage in the development of a…
questions.x: A tadpole lives in water and breathes with gills.

questions.he: איזה חרק עובר גלגול חסר?
questions.q: Which insect goes through incomplete metamorphosis?
questions.x: Incomplete metamorphosis – no pupa stage.

questions.he: הפריה פנימית מתרחשת…
questions.q: Internal fertilization takes place…
questions.x: This happens in mammals, birds and reptiles.

questions.he: לרוב הדגים יש הפריה…
questions.q: In most fish, fertilization is…
questions.x: The eggs are fertilized in the water.

questions.he: למה דגים מטילים אלפי ביצים?
questions.q: Why do fish lay thousands of eggs?
questions.x: This way at least some will survive.

questions.he: באיזה איבר מתפתח העובר של יונקים?
questions.q: In which organ does a mammal's embryo develop?
questions.x: The embryo grows in the uterus, inside the mother's body.

questions.he: מה תפקיד החלמון בביצת תרנגולת?
questions.q: What is the job of the yolk in a chicken egg?
questions.x: The yolk feeds the embryo.

questions.he: מה תפקיד קליפת הביצה?
questions.q: What is the job of the eggshell?
questions.x: The hard shell protects it.

questions.he: ההורים מאכילים את הגורים ומגינים עליהם. איך נקראת התנהגות זו?
questions.q: The parents feed their young and protect them. What is this behavior called?
questions.x: This way more offspring survive, even when there are few.

questions.he: מה תפקיד השליה בהיריון?
questions.q: What is the job of the placenta in pregnancy?
questions.x: Food and oxygen pass through it from the mother's blood to the embryo.

questions.he: כמה זמן נמשך היריון אצל אדם?
questions.q: How long does a human pregnancy last?
questions.x: About 40 weeks.

questions.he: דרך מה העובר מקבל מזון וחמצן?
questions.q: Through what does the embryo get food and oxygen?
questions.x: The umbilical cord connects it to the placenta.

questions.he: איך נקראים תאי הרבייה של האישה?
questions.q: What are a woman's reproductive cells called?
questions.x: Egg cells form in the ovaries.

questions.he: איך נקראים תאי הרבייה של הגבר?
questions.q: What are a man's reproductive cells called?
questions.x: Sperm cells form in the testes.

questions.he: מה גורם לשינויים בגוף בגיל ההתבגרות?
questions.q: What causes the changes in the body during puberty?
questions.x: Hormones – substances that carry "instructions" in the body.

questions.he: מה קורה לקול של בנים בגיל ההתבגרות?
questions.q: What happens to boys' voices during puberty?
questions.x: The vocal cords grow and the voice gets lower.

questions.he: איזה שינוי קורה רק לבנות בגיל ההתבגרות?
questions.q: Which change happens only to girls during puberty?
questions.x: Menstruation – a sign that the body is maturing.

questions.he: על מה חשוב להקפיד בגיל ההתבגרות?
questions.q: What is important to take care of during puberty?
questions.x: More sweat – showers and deodorant.

questions.he: איזה שלב בחיים בא אחרי הילדות?
questions.q: Which stage of life comes after childhood?
questions.x: Infancy → childhood → adolescence → adulthood

questions.he: מה זו "קפיצת גדילה"?
questions.q: What is a "growth spurt"?
questions.x: During puberty, we grow fast.

questions.he: מתי בדרך כלל מתחילות בנות להתבגר?
questions.q: When do girls usually start puberty?
questions.x: Girls usually start a year or two earlier.

questions.he: מי היצרן בשרשרת המזון שבתמונה?
questions.q: Who is the producer in the food chain in the picture?
questions.x: A producer makes food by photosynthesis.

questions.he: מה מקור האנרגיה של כמעט כל מערכת אקולוגית?
questions.q: What is the energy source of almost every ecosystem?
questions.x: Plants take in sunlight.

questions.he: לאיזו קבוצה שייך המזון של צרכן ראשוני?
questions.q: Which group does a primary consumer's food belong to?
questions.x: A primary consumer eats plants, that is, producers.

questions.he: בשרשרת שבתמונה, מי הצרכן השניוני?
questions.q: In the chain in the picture, who is the secondary consumer?
questions.x: The snake eats the primary consumer.

questions.he: מה תפקיד המפרקים במערכת האקולוגית?
questions.q: What is the role of decomposers in an ecosystem?
questions.x: They break down the remains of dead organisms.

questions.he: מה מהבאים הוא מפרק?
questions.q: Which of these is a decomposer?
questions.x: Fungi and bacteria break down remains.

questions.he: במארג, שועל אוכל ארנבות ועכברים. הארנבות נעלמו. מה יאכל השועל?
questions.q: In a food web, a fox eats rabbits and mice. The rabbits disappeared. What will the fox eat?
questions.x: In a food web, a predator has several food sources.

questions.he: בשרשרת שבתמונה כל השועלים נעלמו. מה יקרה לארנבות?
questions.q: In the chain in the picture, all the foxes disappeared. What will happen to the rabbits?
questions.x: No one is left to hunt them.

questions.he: הארנבות התרבו מאוד. מה יקרה לעשב?
questions.q: The rabbits multiplied a lot. What will happen to the grass?
questions.x: More rabbits eat more grass.

questions.he: איך נקרא בעל חיים שאוכל גם צמחים וגם בעלי חיים?
questions.q: What do we call an animal that eats both plants and animals?
questions.x: For example, a bear: fruit, honey and fish.

questions.he: איזה חלק מהאנרגיה עובר לרמה הבאה בשרשרת?
questions.q: What part of the energy passes to the next level in the chain?
questions.x: Most of the energy is used up or lost as heat.

questions.he: לאן הולכת רוב האנרגיה בכל רמה?
questions.q: Where does most of the energy at each level go?
questions.x: The organism uses it to live and be active.

questions.he: למה יש בטבע מעט אריות ומעט נשרים?
questions.q: Why are there few lions and few eagles in nature?
questions.x: Little energy is left at the top of the chain.

questions.he: מה נמצא בבסיס פירמידת האנרגיה?
questions.q: What is at the base of the energy pyramid?
questions.x: Producers have the most energy.

questions.he: לפי הטבלה, כמה יחידות אנרגיה יגיעו לשועל?
questions.q: According to the table, how many energy units will reach the fox?
questions.x: Only about 10% passes on: 1000 ÷ 10 = 100

questions.he: באיזה תהליך צמחים קולטים את אנרגיית השמש?
questions.q: In which process do plants capture the Sun's energy?
questions.x: The sunlight is stored in sugar.

questions.he: איך זורמת האנרגיה במערכת אקולוגית?
questions.q: How does energy flow in an ecosystem?
questions.x: From the Sun to producers to consumers – and it doesn't return.

questions.he: מה קורה לחומרים, כמו פחמן, במערכת אקולוגית?
questions.q: What happens to substances, like carbon, in an ecosystem?
questions.x: Decomposers return them to the soil and the air.

questions.he: איך נקראים יצורים שמייצרים את המזון שלהם בעצמם?
questions.q: What are organisms that make their own food called?
questions.x: Plants and algae are producers.

questions.he: פחות אור מגיע לעומק. איפה בים חיות רוב האצות?
questions.q: Less light reaches the depths. Where in the sea do most algae live?
questions.x: Algae need light for photosynthesis.

questions.he: מה מהבאים הוא גורם דומם (אביוטי) בסביבה?
questions.q: Which of these is an abiotic (nonliving) factor in the environment?
questions.x: An abiotic factor is not alive: light, water, temperature, soil.

questions.he: מה מהבאים הוא גורם חי (ביוטי) בסביבה?
questions.q: Which of these is a biotic (living) factor in the environment?
questions.x: A biotic factor – any living thing that affects the environment.

questions.he: איך נקרא המקום שבו יצור חי מוצא את כל צרכיו?
questions.q: What do we call the place where an organism finds everything it needs?
questions.x: There it has food, water, shelter and suitable conditions.

questions.he: כל האיילים מאותו מין שחיים יחד באותו אזור הם…
questions.q: What do we call all the deer of one species living in one area?
questions.x: A population – individuals of one species in the same place.

questions.he: מה כוללת מערכת אקולוגית?
questions.q: What does an ecosystem include?
questions.x: The living things and their nonliving surroundings affect each other.

questions.he: לפי הגרף – באיזו טמפרטורה נבטו הכי הרבה זרעים?
questions.q: According to the graph, at what temperature did the most seeds sprout?
questions.x: The highest point is above 20.

questions.he: לקקטוס אין עלים, והגבעול שלו ירוק ועבה. מה תפקידו?
questions.q: A cactus has no leaves, and its stem is green and thick. What is the stem's job?
questions.x: With no leaves, the stem does photosynthesis and stores water.

questions.he: לגמל רגליים רחבות ודבשת עם שומן. לאיזו סביבה הוא מותאם?
questions.q: A camel has wide feet and a hump of fat. What environment is it adapted to?
questions.x: Wide feet don't sink into sand; the fat stores energy.

questions.he: לדוב הקוטב שכבת שומן עבה ופרווה צפופה. ממה הן מגינות?
questions.q: A polar bear has a thick layer of fat and dense fur. What do they protect it from?
questions.x: Fat and fur insulate and keep body heat in.

questions.he: מה עושים בעלי חיים רבים במדבר בשעות החום?
questions.q: What do many desert animals do in the hot hours?
questions.x: They are active at night, when it is cool, and rest in shade.

questions.he: מה מתאים את הדג לחיים במים?
questions.q: What adapts a fish to life in water?
questions.x: Gills take oxygen from water; fins help it swim.

questions.he: ינשוף צד עכברים ואוכל אותם. איזה יחס גומלין זה?
questions.q: An owl hunts mice and eats them. What kind of interaction is this?
questions.x: The predator hunts the prey and feeds on it.

questions.he: דבורה שותה צוף ומאביקה את הפרח. איזה יחס גומלין זה?
questions.q: A bee drinks nectar and pollinates the flower. What kind of interaction is this?
questions.x: Both sides gain: the bee gets food, the flower gets pollinated.

questions.he: פרעוש חי על כלב ומוצץ את דמו. איזה יחס גומלין זה?
questions.q: A flea lives on a dog and sucks its blood. What kind of interaction is this?
questions.x: The parasite gains; the host is harmed but stays alive.

questions.he: שני עצים צמודים, ושניהם צריכים אור ומים. איזה יחס גומלין זה?
questions.q: Two trees grow close together, and both need light and water. What kind of interaction is this?
questions.x: Both try to get the same limited resources.

questions.he: אריות ונמרים צדים אותן זברות. מה היחס בין האריות לנמרים?
questions.q: Lions and leopards hunt the same zebras. What is the relationship between the lions and leopards?
questions.x: The two predators compete for the same food.

questions.he: מה נכון לגבי טפיל?
questions.q: What is true about a parasite?
questions.x: It lives on or inside the host and feeds on it.

questions.he: מספר הזאבים באזור גדל מאוד. מה יקרה למספר האיילים?
questions.q: The number of wolves in an area grew a lot. What will happen to the number of deer?
questions.x: More predators eat more deer.

questions.he: מפעל הזרים שפכים לנחל. מה יקרה לדגים בנחל?
questions.q: A factory dumped waste into a stream. What will happen to the fish in it?
questions.x: Water pollution harms the organisms that live in it.

questions.he: למה כביש שחוצה יער פוגע בבעלי החיים?
questions.q: Why does a road crossing a forest harm the animals?
questions.x: It is hard for them to cross, find food and find mates.

questions.he: מה עוזר לשמור על מגוון המינים?
questions.q: What helps preserve the variety of species?
questions.x: In a reserve, habitats are protected and many species live there.

questions.he: המיינה הובאה לישראל מאסיה. מה עזר לה להתפשט?
questions.q: The common myna was brought to Israel from Asia. What helped it spread?
questions.x: Most of the natural enemies that limited it in Asia are missing here.

questions.he: מהו אפקט החממה?
questions.q: What is the greenhouse effect?
questions.x: Gases in the air keep heat from escaping.

questions.he: בלי אפקט החממה, כדור הארץ היה…
questions.q: Without the greenhouse effect, Earth would be…
questions.x: The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm.

questions.he: מה מהבאים הוא גז חממה עיקרי?
questions.q: Which of these is a main greenhouse gas?
questions.x: CO₂ traps heat in the atmosphere.

questions.he: איזה מהם גז חממה שנפלט מפרות ומאשפה?
questions.q: Which of these is a greenhouse gas given off by cows and garbage?
questions.x: Methane – CH₄, a powerful greenhouse gas.

questions.he: מה מוסיף הכי הרבה פחמן דו-חמצני לאוויר בגלל האדם?
questions.q: Because of humans, what adds the most carbon dioxide to the air?
questions.x: Coal, oil and gas in power plants and cars.

questions.he: מה קולט פחמן דו-חמצני מהאוויר?
questions.q: What takes in carbon dioxide from the air?
questions.x: In photosynthesis, the plant takes in CO₂.

questions.he: מה פולטים בעלי חיים בנשימה?
questions.q: What do animals give off when they breathe?
questions.x: They breathe in oxygen and breathe out CO₂.

questions.he: מה קורה לכמות הפחמן הדו-חמצני באוויר לפי הגרף?
questions.q: According to the graph, what is happening to the amount of carbon dioxide in the air?
questions.x: The points are higher every year.

questions.he: מה מהבאים אינו דלק מאובנים?
questions.q: Which of these is not a fossil fuel?
questions.x: Fossil fuels formed over millions of years.

questions.he: מאיפה הגיע הפחמן שבנפט?
questions.q: Where did the carbon in oil come from?
questions.x: Remains of plants and organisms from millions of years ago.

questions.he: לפי הקטע, מה כולא חלק מהחום ליד כדור הארץ?
questions.q: According to the passage, what traps some of the heat near Earth?
questions.x: Some of it is trapped by greenhouse gases.

questions.he: מה הטמפרטורה הממוצעת בזכות אפקט החממה?
questions.q: What is the average temperature thanks to the greenhouse effect?
questions.x: The average temperature is pleasant: about 15 degrees.

questions.he: מתי התחילו בני האדם לשרוף הרבה דלקים?
questions.q: When did people start burning large amounts of fuel?
questions.x: Since the Industrial Revolution, about two hundred years ago.

questions.he: למה כריתת יערות מגדילה את כמות גזי החממה?
questions.q: Why does cutting down forests increase greenhouse gases?
questions.x: Fewer trees take in the gas from the air.

questions.he: בכמה עלתה הטמפרטורה הממוצעת לפי הקטע?
questions.q: According to the passage, by how much has the average temperature risen?
questions.x: It has risen by more than one degree.

questions.he: איזו תוצאה של ההתחממות מוזכרת בקטע?
questions.q: Which result of the warming is mentioned in the passage?
questions.x: Glaciers are melting, and the sea level is rising.

questions.he: מה קורה לגובה פני הים לפי הקטע?
questions.q: According to the passage, what is happening to the sea level?
questions.x: Water from the melting glaciers flows into the sea.

questions.he: למה מינים רבים בסכנה, לפי הקטע?
questions.q: According to the passage, why are many species in danger?
questions.x: They have trouble adapting to the changes.

questions.he: איזו דרך פעולה מוזכרת בקטע?
questions.q: Which course of action does the passage mention?
questions.x: Travel by public transportation or by bicycle.

questions.he: למה חשמל מהשמש ומהרוח עוזר נגד ההתחממות?
questions.q: Why does electricity from the sun and wind help against warming?
questions.x: No carbon dioxide is released.

questions.he: מה הרעיון המרכזי של הקטע?
questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.x: The passage explains why it happens and what we can do.

questions.he: מותר להוציא על הפרויקט רק 50 ₪. איך נקראת מגבלה כזו?
questions.q: You may spend only 50 ₪ on the project. What is such a limit called?
questions.x: A constraint – a limit of money, time or materials.

questions.he: מתכננים בקבוק לטיולים. מה מהבאים הוא דרישה מהמוצר?
questions.q: We are designing a bottle for hikes. Which of these is a requirement for the product?
questions.x: A requirement – what the product must do to meet the need.

questions.he: הגשר צריך להיות חזק מאוד אבל גם זול. מה עושים?
questions.q: The bridge must be very strong but also cheap. What do we do?
questions.x: Conflicting requirements – we look for the most balanced solution.

questions.he: בנו דגם גשר מקשים. איך בודקים כמה הוא חזק?
questions.q: A model bridge was built from straws. How do we test how strong it is?
questions.x: In a test, we measure performance and compare it to the requirements.

questions.he: לפי הטבלה – איזה דגם גשר נשא הכי הרבה משקל?
questions.q: According to the table, which bridge model held the most weight?
questions.x: 7 kg – more than 5 and 3.

questions.he: הדרישה: לשאת לפחות 5 ק״ג. לפי הטבלה – אילו דגמים עומדים בה?
questions.q: The requirement: hold at least 5 kg. According to the table, which models meet it?
questions.x: 7 and 5 are at least 5; 3 is less.

questions.he: למה משרטטים את הפתרון לפני שבונים?
questions.q: Why do we draw the solution before building it?
questions.x: A drawing reveals mistakes early, before material is wasted.

questions.he: משתמשים אמרו שהכיסא החדש לא נוח. מה עושים עם המשוב?
questions.q: Users said the new chair is uncomfortable. What do we do with the feedback?
questions.x: Based on the feedback, we improve the model and test it again.

questions.he: מוצר חדש נבדק בחום, בקור ובגשם. למה?
questions.q: A new product is tested in heat, cold and rain. Why?
questions.x: People will use it in different conditions.

questions.he: מה הופך מוצר לידידותי יותר לסביבה?
questions.q: What makes a product more environmentally friendly?
questions.x: Recycling saves raw materials and reduces waste.

questions.he: במערכת השקיה אוטומטית, חיישן מפעיל ברז. מה החיישן מודד?
questions.q: In an automatic irrigation system, a sensor turns on a tap. What does the sensor measure?
questions.x: The sensor checks how wet the soil is – that is the input.

questions.he: מערכת השקיה אוטומטית – מה הפלט שלה?
questions.q: An automatic irrigation system – what is its output?
questions.x: The tap opens, and water flows to the plant.

questions.he: המזגן נעצר כשהחדר מגיע ל-24 מעלות. איזה רכיב מאפשר זאת?
questions.q: The air conditioner stops when the room reaches 24 degrees. Which component makes this possible?
questions.x: The sensor measures, and the system compares it to the desired temperature.

questions.he: מערכת שבודקת את התוצאה ומתקנת את עצמה היא מערכת…
questions.q: A system that checks its result and corrects itself is a system…
questions.x: Feedback – the output comes back and affects how the system works.

questions.he: רמזור חכם מאריך את הירוק כשיש תור. מה הקלט שלו?
questions.q: A smart traffic light keeps the green longer when cars are waiting. What is its input?
questions.x: A sensor counts the cars, and the light decides accordingly.

questions.he: הרובוט עוצר לפני קיר. איזה רכיב קלט מאפשר זאת?
questions.q: The robot stops before a wall. Which input component makes this possible?
questions.x: The sensor takes in information; motor, speaker and bulb are outputs.

questions.he: איזה חלק ברובוט מספק לו אנרגיה?
questions.q: Which part of the robot supplies it with energy?
questions.x: Every system needs an energy source.

questions.he: צריך מסגרת קלה לאופניים. שני החומרים בכרטיס חזקים מספיק. מה עדיף?
questions.q: A bike needs a light frame. Both materials on the card are strong enough. Which is better?
questions.x: Lower density – the same volume weighs less.

questions.he: צינורות מים בבתים חדשים עשויים מפלסטיק ולא מברזל. למה?
questions.q: Water pipes in new houses are made of plastic, not iron. Why?
questions.x: Iron rusts in contact with water and oxygen.

questions.he: למה בתוך קסדת אופניים יש שכבת קצף?
questions.q: Why is there a layer of foam inside a bike helmet?
questions.x: The foam is crushed and absorbs the blow, and weighs almost nothing.

questions.he: מה החיסרון של זכוכית בחלונות?
questions.q: What is the disadvantage of glass in windows?
questions.x: Glass is brittle – that is why there is also tempered glass.

questions.he: מלח בישול בנוי מנתרן ומכלור. מלח הוא…
questions.q: Table salt is made of sodium and chlorine. Salt is a…
questions.x: Two kinds of atoms bonded together.

questions.he: איזה חלקיק נמצא מחוץ לגרעין?
questions.q: Which particle is found outside the nucleus?
questions.x: Electrons move around the nucleus.

questions.he: מה הנוסחה של המולקולה בכרטיס?
questions.q: What is the formula of the molecule on the card?
questions.x: One carbon atom and two oxygen atoms.

questions.he: אלומיניום מוליך חשמל ומבריק. הוא…
questions.q: Aluminum conducts electricity and is shiny. It is a…
questions.x: Conductivity and shine – properties of metals.

questions.he: שרפו 12 גרם פחמן עם 32 גרם חמצן. כמה גרם תוצר?
questions.q: 12 g of carbon were burned with 32 g of oxygen. How many grams of product?
questions.x: Conservation of mass: 12 + 32 = 44

questions.he: מתח ⁦12⁩ וולט, זרם ⁦4⁩ אמפר. מה ההתנגדות?
questions.q: Voltage 12 volts, current 4 amperes. What is the resistance?
questions.x: Resistance = voltage ÷ current: 12 ÷ 4 = 3

questions.he: בבית נשרפה נורה במטבח. האור בסלון…
questions.q: A light bulb in the kitchen burned out. The light in the living room…
questions.x: Homes are wired in parallel.

questions.he: מזגן של 2000 וואט פעל 3 שעות. כמה קוט״ש?
questions.q: A 2,000-watt air conditioner ran for 3 hours. How many kWh?
questions.x: 2 × 3 = 6 – kilowatts times hours

questions.he: איזה כוח מחזיק את הירח במסלול סביב כדור הארץ?
questions.q: What force keeps the Moon in orbit around Earth?
questions.x: Earth pulls on the Moon.

questions.he: כוח 40 ניוטון ימינה ו-40 ניוטון שמאלה. מה השקול?
questions.q: 40 N to the right and 40 N to the left. Which of these is the net force?
questions.x: Equal and opposite forces cancel each other out.

questions.he: מפה מונחת על שולחן. מושכים אותה מהר – הצלחות נשארות. למה?
questions.q: A tablecloth lies on a table. Pull it fast – the plates stay. Why?
questions.x: The plates stay at rest.

questions.he: רכבת נסעה 300 ק״מ ב-3 שעות. מה מהירותה?
questions.q: A train traveled 300 km in 3 hours. What is its speed?

questions.he: לפי הגרף, מה עשה הגוף?
questions.q: According to the graph, what did the object do?
questions.x: A straight rising line – constant speed.

questions.he: דבורה עוברת מפרח לפרח. מה היא עושה לצמח?
questions.q: A bee goes from flower to flower. What does it do for the plant?
questions.x: It carries pollen to the stigma.

questions.he: שתילת ייחור של ורד נותנת צמח…
questions.q: Planting a rose cutting produces a plant…
questions.x: Asexual reproduction – a copy of the parent.

questions.he: אצל איזה בעל חיים יש שלב גולם?
questions.q: Which animal has a pupa stage?
questions.x: Pupa – in the complete metamorphosis of insects.

questions.he: מה מסמן את תחילת גיל ההתבגרות?
questions.q: What marks the start of puberty?
questions.x: Hormones start the changes.

questions.he: בשרשרת שבתמונה, מי הצרכן הראשוני?
questions.q: In the chain in the picture, who is the primary consumer?
questions.x: The grasshopper eats the plant.

questions.he: מה יקרה לשרשרת אם ייעלמו כל הצמחים?
questions.q: What will happen to the chain if all the plants disappear?
questions.x: Without producers, there is no energy for anyone.

questions.he: מה מהבאים מקטין פליטת גזי חממה?
questions.q: Which of these reduces greenhouse gas emissions?
questions.x: Fewer cars – less fuel burned.

questions.he: למה שתילת עצים עוזרת נגד ההתחממות?
questions.q: Why does planting trees help against warming?
questions.x: In photosynthesis, trees take in carbon dioxide.
